facts.note: Transcript gives the same reading: at the nine o'clock bell the watch showed twenty minutes to nine, and the uncle made a scene about it in front of everyone.
Transcript says he went up to the library after dinner and stayed there alone.
Transcript gives the 10:18 thump right above in the atelier, then the repeater: ten slow deep notes counted, then doubled notes, then quick high ones not counted.
Transcript gives someone going quickly up past the library door at 10:15 by his watch and someone coming quickly down at 10:21, with no one seen and the door shut both times.
Transcript gives Bastien Girard entering at 10:32 by his watch and the two sitting together until the temple struck eleven.
